title: Bank Account Changes and Re-Verification: Northloop Payments Plan Terms
content:
Bank details and periodic re-verification of a Northloop Payments account run on five plan terms.

| Payout plan | Payments Starter | Payments Biweekly | Payments Weekly | Payments Daily | Payments Daily Plus | Payments Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bank change payout hold (calendar days after a bank account change) | 7 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Bank account holder name must match the profile or business name | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Returned payout re-sent within (business days after updated bank details are verified) | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 |
| Re-verification interval (months) | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Re-verification grace (calendar days after it falls due) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |

## Definitions

- **Bank change payout hold** — calendar days after a bank account change during which no payout is sent.
- **Name match** — whether the bank account holder name must match the profile or business name; required on every plan.
- **Returned payout resend** — business days after updated bank details are verified by which a returned payout is re-sent.
- **Re-verification interval** — months between mandatory identity and bank re-verifications.
- **Re-verification grace** — calendar days after a re-verification falls due before payouts are held.

Only the bank change payout hold differs by plan: 7 calendar days on Payments Starter and 3 on every other plan.
